Definition: the Spanish broom (from its pole-like stems)
BiblicalUsage: Elijah sat down under a juniper tree and requested for himself that he might die, and slept under it until the angel touched him. The outcasts cut up mallows by the bushes and juniper roots for their meat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the juniper is the tree of the weary, and God meets His tired servants under it.
